tasks.title: Refactor Dockerfile for frontend
tasks.description: Refactor Dockerfile for frontend so it is possible to build the application and run it over 'nginx'.

tasks.title: Refactor Dockerfiles for frontend and backend
tasks.description: Refactor Dockerfiles for frontend and backend so that I don't have to run `docker compose up --build -d` every time.

tasks.title: Add possibility to hot-swap java code without rebuilding the image
Setup devcontainer
Add Web tests
[Bug] Fix creating a bug report: updated_at is never set
tasks.description:
Oddities.md > Open questions #1.
VERIFIED: POST /api/reports answers 409 for valid input; backend log shows "Column 'updated_at' cannot be null". BugReportService never sets updatedAt on create, but bug_report.updated_at is NOT NULL.
- set updatedAt on create and on every update
- add a test that saves through the real database (the mocked service tests do not catch this)

tasks.title: [Verify] Check 404 for missing comment in CommentAuthorizer
tasks.description:
Oddities.md > Open questions #2.
PARTLY VERIFIED: PATCH /api/reports/{unknownId}/severity answers 404 (BugReportAuthorizer), so the exception is not turned into a 500 there.
Still to check: DELETE /api/comments/{unknownId} (CommentAuthorizer), and decide whether authorizers should throw at all or return false (403).

tasks.title: [Bug] Validate responsibleUserId when creating or changing a component
tasks.description:
Oddities.md > Open questions #3 and Backend > Behavior.
VERIFIED: POST /api/components without a user or with an unknown user answers a generic 409 "Request conflicts with existing data." (database foreign key / NOT NULL). updateResponsibleUserId has the same gap.
- add @NotNull to CreateComponentRequest.responsibleUserId
- check the user exists in ComponentService (404, like other services)
- show a clear message in CreateComponentForm

tasks.title: [Bug] Make run-backend.sh work on the host
tasks.description:
Oddities.md > Open questions #4.
VERIFIED: ./run-backend.sh fails with "Socket fail to connect to database" because application.yml uses the Compose host names database, artemis and mailpit. Workaround (SPRING_DATASOURCE_URL) is in README, but Artemis 61616 and SMTP 1025 are also not published by docker-compose.yml, so no emails.
Options: publish the ports and add a local Spring profile pointing to localhost, or run the backend only through Compose and remove the script.

tasks.title: [Design] Decide how ASSIGNED status and assignment events should work
tasks.description:
Oddities.md > Backend > Behavior.
- create with an assignee leaves the status OPEN and publishes no event
- updateAssignee never sets ASSIGNED but publishes an event
- the UI does not change the status when the assignee changes either
Decide whether assigning should set ASSIGNED and whether create should notify the assignee.

tasks.title: [Design] Define status transition rules and skip no-op notifications
tasks.description:
Oddities.md > Backend > Behavior.
updateStatus only rejects CLOSED; any other status can be set at any time, and a notification is published even if the status did not change. Decide on allowed transitions (see the lifecycle diagram in the README) and do not email when nothing changed.

tasks.title: [Design] Check that a report's component belongs to its project
tasks.description:
Oddities.md > Backend > Behavior.
updateComponent does not verify the component belongs to the report's project. The schema has no component -> project link at all, so first decide whether components belong to a project.

tasks.title: [Refactor] Query developers in the database instead of filtering in memory
tasks.description:
Oddities.md > Backend > Behavior.
UserAccountService.getDevelopers loads all accounts and filters by role in memory. Use a repository query by role (findAllByRole exists).

tasks.title: [Design] Decide on archiving: implement it or drop archived_at
tasks.description:
Oddities.md > Backend > Behavior.
The archived_at column exists on user_account, software_project and component, but no entity, mapper or query uses it.

tasks.title: [Refactor] Simplify BugReport builder and mapper handling of id, status and resolution
tasks.description:
Oddities.md > Backend > Behavior.
The builder always starts a report as OPEN and cannot set id, status or resolution; BugReportMapper.toDomain sets them afterwards with setters. Consider a cleaner way to rebuild a report from the database.

tasks.title: [Refactor] Fix the misleading comment about comment removal in SecurityConfig
tasks.description:
Oddities.md > Backend > Security and access.
The comment says comment removal is "an administrative action", but the URL rule only needs a signed-in user and the service allows ADMIN or the comment's author. Fix the comment (or change the rule).

tasks.title: [Design] Decide who may see which bug reports
tasks.description:
Oddities.md > Backend > Security and access.
GET /api/reports returns all reports to every signed-in user (no filtering by owner or project).

tasks.title: [Refactor] Make the CORS origin configurable
tasks.description:
Oddities.md > Backend > Security and access.
SecurityConfig hard-codes http://localhost:5173 as the only allowed origin. Move it to a property.

tasks.title: [Refactor] Avoid a database lookup on every request in CurrentUserAuthenticationFilter
tasks.description:
Oddities.md > Backend > Security and access.
The filter reloads the user on each request so role changes apply immediately. Decide if that trade-off is fine or if caching is needed.

tasks.title: [Security] Stop logging demo passwords and hard-coding them at startup
tasks.description:
Oddities.md > Backend > Security and access.
Demo passwords are hard-coded in BugReportApplication and written to the log at startup (only BCrypt hashes are stored). Limit to a dev profile or read from configuration.

tasks.title: [Security] Move credentials out of application.yml
tasks.description:
Oddities.md > Backend > Security and access.
application.yml contains database, Artemis and mail credentials in plain text (development defaults). Use environment variables or profiles for anything beyond local development.

tasks.title: [Verify] Check error responses for unexpected errors, 405 and 415
tasks.description:
Oddities.md > Backend > Security and access.
ApiExceptionHandler handles a fixed list of exceptions. Check what the client receives for unhandled exceptions (500), unsupported methods (405) and media types (415), and whether they should use the {"message": ...} body.

tasks.title: [Bug] Return the resolution id with a correct field name from the close endpoint
tasks.description:
Oddities.md > Backend > API design.
POST /api/reports/{id}/resolution returns { reportId, message }, but reportId holds the id of the new resolution (VERIFIED). Rename the field or return the report id.

tasks.title: [Refactor] Add a ResolutionResponse DTO
tasks.description:
Oddities.md > Backend > API design.
BugReportResponse serializes the domain Resolution object directly, tying the API shape to the domain class.

tasks.title: [Design] Unify DTO field names
tasks.description:
Oddities.md > Backend > API design.
UserAccountResponse.username holds the display name (login name is email); ids are named id / userId / reportId; names are username / name / author. Agree on one naming scheme (this changes the API and the frontend).

tasks.title: [Design] Use one timestamp format in all responses
tasks.description:
Oddities.md > Backend > API design.
BugReportBriefResponse.createdAt is a formatted string (dd-MM-yyyy HH:mm); every other timestamp is ISO-8601.

tasks.title: [Design] Make PATCH /api/accounts/{id}/role consistent with other updates
tasks.description:
Oddities.md > Backend > API design.
It returns 204 without a body, while the other update endpoints return 200 with {id, message}.

tasks.title: [Design] Use one path style for update endpoints
tasks.description:
Oddities.md > Backend > API design.
Component uses the camelCase segment /responsibleUserId; report endpoints use kebab-case (/steps-to-reproduce).

tasks.title: [Bug] Use reporterName in the assignee-changed email or remove it
tasks.description:
Oddities.md > Backend > Messaging.
AssigneeChangedEvent.reporterName is never used in the email text.

tasks.title: [Refactor] Make the email sender address configurable
tasks.description:
Oddities.md > Backend > Messaging.
no-reply@bugreport.local is hard-coded in BugReportEventConsumer.

tasks.title: [Design] Handle failures when publishing events
tasks.description:
Oddities.md > Backend > Messaging.
BugReportEventPublisher does not catch send failures; the database change is already committed when sending fails. Decide on logging, retry or an outbox.

tasks.title: [Bug] Fix the not-found message in CommentAuthorizer
tasks.description:
Oddities.md > Backend > Small things.
It says "Report with id" when a comment is missing.

tasks.title: [Refactor] Fix the misleading in-memory database comment in BugReportApplication
tasks.description:
Oddities.md > Backend > Small things.
The comment "These accounts exist only in the in-memory demo database" is wrong: the app and the tests use MariaDB.

tasks.title: [Design] Decide the future of Attachment
tasks.description:
Oddities.md > Backend > Small things.
Attachment exists only in the domain module (no entity, repository or endpoint); the demo seeding code is commented out. Implement attachments or remove the class.

tasks.title: [Design] Decide whether to map JPA associations
tasks.description:
Oddities.md > Backend > Small things.
Only BugReportEntity.resolution is a JPA association; other relations are plain UUID columns with foreign keys only in V1__Base.sql, so services load related rows by hand.

tasks.title: [Bug] Prevent write requests before the CSRF token is loaded
tasks.description:
Oddities.md > Frontend.
getCsrfToken() returns null fields until the token is loaded, so a write request sent too early would use a header named "null".

tasks.title: [Refactor] Replace jQuery ($.ajax) with fetch
tasks.description:
Oddities.md > Frontend.
jQuery is used for all requests although fetch is available.

tasks.title: [Refactor] Clean up the api modules
tasks.description:
Oddities.md > Frontend.
- api files differ in style (quoted "url" keys, missing semicolons)
- api/create-bug-report-options.js duplicates getAllProjects and getAllComponents

tasks.title: [UX] Show a message when login fails
tasks.description:
Oddities.md > Frontend.
A failed login is only written to the browser console; the user sees nothing. (The Register button is covered by the existing task "Implement register functionality".)

tasks.title: [Bug] Use the router link in BugReportRow
tasks.description:
Oddities.md > Frontend.
BugReportRow uses a plain <a href>, which reloads the whole page; use React Router's Link.

tasks.title: [UX] Show a loading indicator in ProtectedRoute
tasks.description:
Oddities.md > Frontend.
ProtectedRoute renders nothing while the session check is running.

tasks.title: [Refactor] Replace Bootstrap modal DOM handling with React state
tasks.description:
Oddities.md > Frontend.
Modal relies on Bootstrap's JavaScript, and pages open and close modals with document.getElementById plus the Bootstrap Modal API, mixing DOM access with React state.

tasks.title: [Bug] Do not send empty strings for optional fields in CreateBugReportForm
tasks.description:
Oddities.md > Frontend.
Optional text fields left empty are sent as empty strings; omit them or send null.

tasks.title: [Refactor] Make the Toast timeout configurable
tasks.description:
Oddities.md > Frontend.
Toast uses a hard-coded 5-second timeout.

tasks.title: [Bug] Add a route for unknown paths and redirect signed-in users away from /login
tasks.description:
Oddities.md > Frontend.
App.jsx has no route for unknown paths, and /login stays reachable for signed-in users.

tasks.title: [Bug] Show an error state when loading a bug report fails
tasks.description:
Oddities.md > Frontend > BugReportPage.
If GET /api/reports/{id} fails, the page shows "Loading bug report..." forever (only a toast appears).

tasks.title: [Bug] Select the current option by id, not by name, in BugReportPage
tasks.description:
Oddities.md > Frontend > BugReportPage.
The current option of a select is found by comparing the displayed name with option labels, so duplicate names can select the wrong option. The report response only has names, so the API needs to return ids too.

tasks.title: [Bug] Refresh the report after closing it in BugReportPage
tasks.description:
Oddities.md > Frontend > BugReportPage.
After closing, the local state stores the form draft as the resolution (no id, no resolvedAt) and does not refresh updatedAt until the page is reloaded.

tasks.title: [UX] Check for blank comment text in the UI
tasks.description:
Oddities.md > Frontend > BugReportPage.
The backend rejects a blank comment (400) and only a generic error toast appears.

tasks.title: [Refactor] Share EditableName and description-modal code between the admin pages
tasks.description:
Oddities.md > Frontend.
ProjectAdminPage and ComponentAdminPage duplicate the inline EditableName component and the description-modal logic.

tasks.title: [Refactor] Guard auth.currentUser in ProjectAdminPage
tasks.description:
Oddities.md > Frontend.
ProjectAdminPage reads auth.currentUser.role without a null check; it is only safe because ProtectedRoute guards the page.

tasks.title: [UX] Stop admins from editing their own role in UserAdminPage
tasks.description:
Oddities.md > Frontend.
An admin can start editing their own role although the backend refuses it (only a generic toast is shown).

tasks.title: [Refactor] Filter and page users on the server in UserAdminPage
tasks.description:
Oddities.md > Frontend.
UserAdminPage loads all users and filters and pages them in the browser.

tasks.title: [UX] Add a close (X) button to the description modals of the admin pages
tasks.description: Oddities.md > Frontend.

tasks.title: [Refactor] Load form option lists lazily in HomePage and BugReportPage
tasks.description:
Oddities.md > Frontend.
Developers, projects and components are loaded on mount even if the create form or the select fields are never used.

tasks.title: [Bug] Fix argument handling in run-backend.sh
tasks.description:
Oddities.md > Scripts and infrastructure.
With two or more arguments it prints a message but exits with status 0 (a bare exit); an unknown single argument is ignored silently.

tasks.title: [Bug] Make the Vite proxy target configurable
tasks.description:
Oddities.md > Scripts and infrastructure.
frontend/vite.config.js proxies /api to http://backend:8080, which only resolves inside the Compose network, so npm run dev on the host has no working backend (VERIFIED by config; documented in README).

tasks.title: [Infra] Pin Docker image versions
tasks.description:
Oddities.md > Scripts and infrastructure.
docker-compose.yml uses the latest tag for mariadb and apache/activemq-artemis (and axllent/mailpit has no tag either), so versions are not pinned.

tasks.title: [Infra] Remove the hard-coded jar name from backend/Dockerfile
tasks.description:
Oddities.md > Scripts and infrastructure.
The Dockerfile copies bug-report-api-0.1.0-SNAPSHOT.jar, so changing the version in the pom breaks the image build.

tasks.title: [Infra] Create the bug_report_test database on existing volumes
tasks.description:
Oddities.md > Scripts and infrastructure.
database/init/01-create-test-database.sql only runs on an empty volume, so an existing volume never gets bug_report_test and the integration tests fail. (README documents a manual command, VERIFIED.)
